scope: Static source evidence for the ordinary 30-profile per-unit indicator panel. No original code, GUI, native server, or hardware acceptance is implied.

controller_rules.load: Flash checkboxes load bound model values with ClicksDisabled. Bind only visible backlight, first-press, nightlight and timer controls. Unbound hidden checkboxes retain false. The ordinary key-press checkbox begins false and the duration combo begins at index -1. Populate selects the brightness radio, sets key-press checked from duration > 0, chooses the matching duration 1..15 (or first item for zero), calls the key-press handler with nil sender, then calls the nightlight handler with nil sender.
controller_rules.initial_key_press_click: Setting the initially false checkbox true invokes its handler before the duration selection. Item[-1] returns an empty string, StrToIntDef returns zero, and StoreKeyPressBrightness leaves a positive loaded model duration unchanged.
controller_rules.no_op_checkbox: TCustomCheckBox.SetState returns before Changed/Click when state is unchanged. Operations preserve this suppression.
controller_rules.key_press_changed: When sender is nonnil, checked is false and nightlight is checked, clear nightlight unless the independent-nightlight flag is true, and clear first-press if checked. Then slider, duration and percentage controls follow key-press checked; nightlight enabled = checked OR independent; colour and first-press enabled = checked AND nightlight checked. Store selected positive duration if checked, otherwise zero.
controller_rules.nightlight_changed: When nightlight is unchecked, clear checked first-press. First-press enabled = nightlight visible/enabled/checked AND key-press visible/enabled/checked. Colour enabled = colour visible AND nightlight checked/enabled. Note enabled = nightlight visible/enabled/checked.
controller_rules.radio: Brightness fixed/group/first-block radios select source 0/1/2. Fixed enables its slider; group enables existing-group selector; first-block enables neither. First-block radio visibility requires firmware >= 1.8.0. Selecting an unchanged checked radio is a no-op. The source setter only changes its source attribute; selecting a radio does not change the remembered fixed level or slider position.

sliders.runtime_update_mode: SetupFlashComponents passes 1 to PrepareFlashCxTrackBar, overriding both DFM umExit values with umChange.
sliders.fixed_edit_level: floor(position * 255 / 100), followed by the unit brightness byte encoding on save
sliders.same_position: SetPosition returns before change notification when the clamped position equals the old position; unedited raw levels therefore survive.
sliders.initial_binding: DoFlashHandleChanged locks controller updates during SetPosition callbacks; Apply refuses model writes while locked, resets dirty, restores the model cache, then unlocks.

controller_rules.hidden_nightlight_control: Checkbox and both warnings are explicitly hidden regardless of profile. No operation exposes it.
controller_rules.ordered_eligibility: Before each explicit edit, require its control to be visible and enabled. Replay callbacks in order; do not replace the history with independent field assignment or caller-provided settled state.
controller_rules.duration_change: Duration combo OnChange only calls StoreKeyPressBrightness; it does not recalculate checkbox dependencies.
controller_rules.hidden_ui_values: Unbound hidden backlight remains unchecked and disabled per DFM. The hidden nightlight colour radio retains its unselected DFM index -1; its stored model ordinal remains separate.

boundaries: KEYE remains excluded: nonidentity agent reordering and its four-column KeyMask lifecycle require separate proof.
Brightness group creation/selection and other Neo parent panels remain outside the bounded indicator projection.
Static verification is not execution of the original GUI; Apply/Cancel and hardware timing remain separate acceptance.

owned_load_save_rules.brightness_ordinary: Raw0 loads group; raw1..3 load first-block; raw>=4 loads fixed. Fixed special raw4/5/6 load model0/2/5. Fixed save applies ordered replacements5->6,2->5,0->4. Group saves0; first-block saves1. Unedited ordinary fixed bytes otherwise survive.
owned_load_save_rules.brightness_classic: Virtual SetIndicatorBrightnessAsByte calls Core, then rewrites a loaded first-block source to fixed with model level equal to raw1/2/3. Thus loaded2 saves5. Virtual GetIndicatorBrightnessAsByte overrides a selected first-block source by encoding its remembered fixed level instead of emitting1.
owned_load_save_rules.style: All eight IndicatorFunction slots load/save. Reflection and Classic load raw3 as runtime2. PrimaryColour loads/saves per-slot except Reflection runtimecolour0 and savedraw1.
owned_load_save_rules.nightlight: EnableNightlight always saves0. Standard (including Decorator) saves the model flag to PA6 and clears PCx; other admitted non-Classic profiles save PCx and clear PA6. Classic clears both.
owned_load_save_rules.classic_hidden_globals: Classic skips loading FirstKeyThrowAway, IndicatorPressedLevel, TimerDuration and EnableNightlightControl; constructor defaults are false/zero. Save clears those fields and IDBacklightIllumination. Timer flash still loads/saves its inverse flag because IsKEYC is true for all admitted Classic classes.
owned_load_save_rules.hidden_nightlight_control: All non-Classic profiles load/save the hidden EnableNightlightControl flag. Classic skips load and saves its false constructor default. No explicit operation is exposed.
owned_load_save_rules.nightlight_colour: NeoPro loads raw1 as ordinal1 and every other raw as0; its before-save marks the field programmable only for IsNeoSaturn, including Decorator. Editable radio visibility remains narrower: Saturn and Pro and not Decorator.
owned_load_save_rules.ownership: These statements describe the bounded indicator-owned projection. Other parent-agent fields and parent Apply/Cancel side effects remain excluded.
